name: DeFleur Video (Testing)
short_desc: Testing build: Hermes-operated video edit API (upload, cut, captions, portrait preview).
author: Humanity Labs; workflow contract informed by Wizard Modules
description: Testing release for hands-on feedback. Private API that Hermes (or any HTTP client) drives: upload an MP4, save edit decisions, render a 9:16 preview with cuts, burned captions and a fixed portrait crop, then download review artifacts. No browser UI. Transcription/alignment, audio lock, semantic motion and final delivery are not built yet. See HERMES.md for connection steps.

form_fields.label: Private video API bearer token
form_fields.hint: At least 32 random ASCII characters, no spaces. Keep this single-owner API private.
